children.text: This is not originally my build, but I made this so that it's on the site. Also I will explain things as if you were a new person.

To be able to use your Doggy (4th ability), you need to do your sidequest for your character type.  To do this, open up your map and press Q, it  should open up your side menu and you need to look for your Warlock's ability quest. It will have a Purple logo.

You WILL NOT be able to do T12 yet untill you change some of the affixes, this build is not set in stone yet. I was able to solo bosses on T9, but I also have not masterworked everything yet. Once you do, it may be possible.
My Personal Skill Rotation goes as follows:
(Your 1 if you put the skills in the same place as me) (DO NOT UNCAST UNTILL IT RUNS OUT OR YOU ARE NEARLY DEAD)
(Your 2 for the same reason) every few seconds so it's always up, boosting your damage.
(Your 4) for the dog to spawn in if he isn't already there
(Your left click) to have a DOOM 2 Lost soul circle around you and hit things that get close as well as summoning another one to hit stuff that you are clicking on
If you are in danger, use a potion and occasionally cast
(Your 1) (DO NOT UNCAST UNTILL IT RUNS OUT OR YOU ARE NEARLY DEAD)
This is for massive damage reduction from monsters and a damage boost for you
(Your 2) every few seconds so it's always up, boosting your damage.
This boosts your damage further as well as occasionally hurting ads around you
(Your Right click) for DOT on the boss
(Your 4) for the dog to spawn in if he isn't already there
Cast it again to make him follow you and deal MASSIVE damage to the boss with giant flame pillars.
This is a dog that basically spams your 3 (
) and deals stupid amounts of damage
(Your left click) to have a DOOM 2 Lost soul circle around you and hit things that get close as well as summoning another one to hit stuff that you are clicking on

To get the glyphs you need (the nodes at the middle of the red diamonds), you can open seasonal caches that you get, do Pit runs (which you unlock on seasonal page 2), and sometimes just by killing stuff (very rare)

strengths: Can nearly insta-kill bosses on T9
weaknesses: If not built correctly, you can accidentally insta-kill yourself
